description: This file manages persistent storage of authentication tokens and user profile data using SharedPreferences. It provides methods to save, clear, and retrieve session information such as JWT tokens and user details for a mobile app.

classes.name: AuthStorage
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods to handle saving, retrieving, and clearing user authentication data and session information in local storage.

methods.name: saveSession
methods.description: Saves authentication tokens and basic user information into persistent storage for session recovery.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Removes all stored user authentication and profile data, effectively logging out the user.

methods.name: readTokens
methods.description: Retrieves stored authentication tokens if available; returns null if not signed in.

methods.name: readUser
methods.description: Retrieves stored user profile details if available; returns null if not signed in.
